explanationBullets: The current seed catalog does not include a dedicated generic mesh guide yet.
Use the generic router guide as the fallback, but expect more app-based wording and bridge-mode edge cases for mesh systems.
If the mesh is in bridge mode, forwarding may need to happen on the gateway at 10.0.0.5.

notes: Same not-seeded-mesh scenario as the other no-mesh-catalog fixture, but with a detected gateway IP supplied: the third explanation bullet's wording changes to name the specific gateway address instead of the generic "another router" phrasing — this is the one place in resolve() (besides unknownRouterHelp's own bullets) where the runtime-detected gateway IP actually changes output text, not just tree-node prose.
